Growth chamber study with only ONE chamber per CO2 level (no chamber replication). This is a pseudoreplication concern - pot replication within chamber is used as the statistical unit.
Zn is reported in mg/kg (not g/100g like other minerals) - unit conversion needed for consistent analysis.
The paper reports PERCENTAGE CHANGES (e.g., P decreased by 36.6%, K by 23.2%, Zn by 32.6%) which are strongly negative, consistent with dilution effect hypothesis. No sign of T/C confusion.
